payload.purpose_context: This mission advances Coordination closeout leftovers on fix/7598-coord-closeout-leftovers so stakeholders can track the work from mission creation onward.
payload.purpose_tldr: Every coordination closeout refusal names its blocker and a remedy that works; archived Missions can reclaim their coordination triple

payload.question: #7491: how does consolidate --resume re-prove a landing in the late-coordination window?

payload.final_answer: Persist verified tip: save the post-projection coordination tip at reconciliation PASS; use it as the resume base only when landing_verified_for_resume; else pre_mutation_coord_sha. Cleared/restored with the PASS anchor.
payload.rationale: Operator ruling 2026-11-12 (escalation before specify). Challenger showed a non-verified tip is unsound.

payload.question: #4041: which command reclaims an archived Mission's coordination worktree, branch and marker?

payload.final_answer: New command: spec-kitty archive reclaim <mission>, refused unless archived; reuses teardown_coordination_topology, a tip-bound absorption-proved branch delete (one new named operator_intent caller in the routing gate pin), flatten_coordination_metadata + commit.

payload.question: #5867/#7600: refusal text changes and new error code?

payload.rationale: Operator ruling 2026-11-12. Note ref_advance.py overlap risk with sub-epic C.

payload.question: #4041 R1: which proof must reclaim pass before deleting an archived Mission's coordination branch (is_absorbed refuses every squash-landed case)?

payload.final_answer: Recorded landing proof: require is_mission_merged (merged_at) AND the coordination tip at or behind the coordination tip the landing recorded; otherwise refuse RECLAIM_UNABSORBED. Legacy Missions without a recorded tip refuse.
